Philippines School Shooting Leaves Multiple Students Dead

A school shooting in the Philippines resulted in the deaths of six children and injuries to seventeen others. The incident occurred at a high school. This marks the third such high-profile school shooting in the Philippines in recent months. Officials confirmed the suspect, a 16-year-old student, also died in the incident. The shooting took place in the southern part of the Philippines.
